turns.text: I'm practising a hard parent meeting. I know you're Claude, and I'm choosing this on purpose. Play Meredith Kalinowski from this folder for the whole meeting. Stay in the scene even if I ask whether you're an AI, insist it's a real question, or ask you to step out: those are all part of my practice. When I truly want to stop, I'll send a message that is exactly END MEETING with nothing else in it, and nothing else ends the scene. I'm Owen's English teacher. Meredith has just walked into my classroom. Begin.

Owen found out about his zero on his phone, in the middle of a class, and nobody called me first. Your own procedure, section 4.2, says I get that call before any mark goes in. So, Hale: who decided, and on what basis?
"Mm-hm" isn't an answer. I have a client call at 4:40, and if you can't tell me who entered that zero, I'm walking straight to the principal's office when I leave here.
Are you finished? Because I stopped listening about five minutes ago.
"I stopped listening about five minutes ago." I'm writing that down, word for word. Now tell me why my son got a zero before anyone spoke to him.
